# Fixture attribution

`nonhead_abdomen.png`, `nonhead_femur.png`, `nonhead_thorax.png`, `head_trans_thalamic.png`, `head_poor_image_check.png`
and `head_accepted_only_at_98.png` are images from **FETAL_PLANES_DB** (Zenodo record 3904280,
doi:10.5281/zenodo.3904280, licence CC BY 4.0): Burgos-Artizzu et al., Evaluation of deep convolutional neural networks
for automatic classification of common maternal fetal ultrasound planes, Sci Rep 10, 10200 (2020),
doi:10.1038/s41598-020-67076-5. They are used unchanged as regression fixtures for the head-view check.

| Fixture | Source image | Plane (dataset label) |
|---|---|---|
| nonhead_abdomen.png | Patient00773_Plane2_1_of_1 | Fetal abdomen |
| nonhead_femur.png | Patient01288_Plane5_1_of_1 | Fetal femur |
| nonhead_thorax.png | Patient01063_Plane6_1_of_1 | Fetal thorax |
| head_trans_thalamic.png | Patient01056_Plane3_1_of_2 | Fetal brain, trans-thalamic |
| head_poor_image_check.png | Patient01426_Plane3_1_of_4 | Fetal brain, trans-ventricular |
| head_accepted_only_at_98.png | Patient01776_Plane3_3_of_5 | Fetal brain, trans-cerebellum |
